## B-344-3 — a newer scheduled plan can still be contradicted by the old receipt

`src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx:120-125,168-179,359-361`: `agrees()` retains a scheduled receipt whenever the new view has `cancelAtPeriodEnd=true` and is not ended; it does not compare the receipt's access-end date or trial facts, and the renderer still prefers that old receipt over the newer view. [Exact panel](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/bc4387ac9f1a35d8ad6746d8ece3cda75fe89ab4/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx).

**Two executed counterexamples, one residual finding:**

1. Cancel returns scheduled access through November 2 → immediate GET fails → Try again returns an authoritative still-scheduled plan with access through December 2. The stale warning disappears and Keep my plan appears, but the line still promises access only through **November 2**. [Failing access-date probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37237449265).
2. The same sequence starts with a trial; the newer view is active/paid-period, cancellation still scheduled, access through December 2. The card still says **“Your free trial ends on November 2, 2026, and nothing is charged.”** [Failing trial-authority probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37237449265).

The subscription contract derives a scheduled plan's `access_ends_at` from its current period and its trial status from the current authoritative state; webhook updates can change period/status while cancellation remains scheduled. A remote Keep, rollover/conversion, then End again is one way to return the flag to true without preserving the old receipt's facts. [Canonical plan view](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/23d2c04c3d05cfc5a6594700152a9cf5336f3111/src/checkout/subscription-plan.ts), [period/status update](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f267417a3ccd0864d3c8ba848323da16225d7aab/src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts).

**Minimal fix rule:** successful reads own current financial/access state. Drop or update a scheduled receipt when its date or trial/access facts conflict with the newer view, or display it separately as labeled historical confirmation rather than the current card line. Preserve receipts through failed reads, the voided-amount/terminal information, canonical resume response and generation fence. Verify both new challenges, the already passing remote-resume case, and the agreeing-trial/failed-read controls. [Affected boundary and reproducible lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37237449265).

The six after reds are two obsolete P3 exact-text pins (new scheduled copy and overdue clause), two obsolete lower-piece false-unpaid wording pins, held C-342-1 zero-price combo, and held Q5 missing Open your plan CTA. The replacement P3 assertions and already-adapted own openPlanAction assertions pass here; none of those six is treated as an infrastructure flake or a new round-5 regression. [Before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235851899), [after](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235878848), [replacement assertion replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37237449265).

Required Typecheck/lint/test is green at the candidate; main-only Analyze remains a composed/main-based landing gate. Grandfathered size **2,958**, with **42** lines before the 3,000 ceiling. [Required CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37236117451), [size and scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5984615650).
